emails.subject: Acknowledgement of Quotation Q-1042
emails.body:
Dear Shakti Precision Components,

We acknowledge receipt of your Quotation Q-1042 dated today, covering:

Item A: 9mm brass casings, 500 units @ INR 120
Item B: Field radio batteries, 200 units @ INR 850
Validity: 30 days. Delivery: 3 weeks from PO.

As requested, our current stock position and next scheduled dispatch dates are:

- 9mm brass casings: 2,400 units held at depot FSD-14; next dispatch scheduled for 2026-11-02.
- Field radio batteries: 1,150 units held at depot FSD-09; next dispatch scheduled for 2026-11-05.

Your quotation will be reviewed and a purchase decision communicated within the validity period.

Regards,
Procurement Office
Defence Supply Office
